description: Discover stock comparison candidates for one exact Bullrun ticker using stored industry or sector classification. Discloses the chosen classification, country preference, deterministic selection order, scan cap and issuer/listing exclusions. Excludes the subject, secondary listings and identifiable duplicate issuers/share classes. Returns compact stored multiples/growth plus ready-to-use compare_stocks arguments. Classification peers are not verified competitors or a financial-similarity ranking; no generated peers or paid graph discovery. Read-only.

limit.description: Maximum peers. compare_stocks supports the subject plus at most four selected peers.

matchBy.description: auto uses exact stored industry when present, otherwise sector. It does not silently widen an empty industry result to the entire sector.

sameCountryOnly.description: Restrict to the subject's exact stored country. Otherwise same-country candidates are shown first, followed by other countries.

ticker.description: Bullrun equity ticker, e.g. AAPL, BMW or 6324.T. Use the listing ticker returned by search_stocks. US/European examples: AAPL, BMW, NESN. Most Asian listings keep their exchange suffix (6324.T, 0700.HK); some use bare codes (005930). Native or suffixed forms resolve only when one listing matches; search by company name or ISIN if unsure.

name: find_stock_peers
title: Discover comparable stock candidates
